official_title: To direct the Director of the National Institute of Standards and Technology to develop best practices for measuring data center energy use, study data availability for the purpose of improving energy demand forecasting capabilities, and for other purposes.
short_title: Data Infrastructure Energy Measurement and Standards Act

summary.text:
Data Infrastructure Energy Measurement and Standards Act

This bill requires the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) to carry out a program to inform the development of best practices, technical standards, and other resources for measuring workloads and energy and water use of data centers, including measurements relating to training and processing of artificial intelligence models.

Specifically, NIST must

develop or identify best practices and other resources for such measurements, taking into account specified factors such as workload type and system configuration;conduct research and testing to improve the accuracy, timeliness, and reliability of such measurements;study data needs for energy and water demand forecasting and other research; andsupport the development of standardized metrics and data sharing mechanisms to promote improved energy and water demand forecasting.Further, NIST must coordinate with the Department of Energy to ensure applicable metrics and data are managed and archived appropriately and promote open exchange of metrics and data as appropriate. NIST must also coordinate with international partners to maintain global data center energy measurement standards.

Finally, NIST must periodically brief Congress on the program.
